title: feat(nmt2x2): M two-tick composition on #7214: reverse HOLD, face HOLD, composition HOLD
science: The same two-tick comparison on the four #7214 x-probes of the x-axis opposite +/-e_2 process: M is unchanged from t to t+1, reverse and face HOLD at both cuts, composition HOLDs. Face HOLD comes from the mixed three-element M(D) that the unique-letter readout would leave UNDEFINED.
